requirements.text: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
requirements.source_phrase: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk

outcomes.description: Transform the image into a chalk drawing.
outcomes.target: The image is rendered as a drawing made from chalk, rather than merely showing an unrelated edit or a partial chalk effect.
outcomes.reference: The input image and the edited image; compare whether the edited image has the appearance of a chalk-made drawing.

nodes.question: Compared with the source, is the edited image consistently rendered as a chalk drawing across the image, rather than showing only a partial chalk-like treatment?
nodes.criteria: Pass if the source has been transformed into a coherent chalk-made drawing across the image, with chalk-like texture and rendering consistently applied to the main subjects and surrounding scene. Fail if there is no requested chalk-drawing progress, or if chalk-like rendering is present but visibly incomplete or inconsistent across the image. Unknown if the source or edited image is unavailable or evidence is insufficient to judge.
nodes.binding: Compare the source and edited images for visible coverage and consistency of the chalk medium across the main subjects and scene; judge the requested chalk-drawing transformation, not a particular style.

program.checker_template: Evaluate ONE independent required condition against the SOURCE and EDITED images. No reference label, previous answers or optimization feedback is supplied. Return pass if the condition is satisfied, fail if it is not satisfied, or unknown if the evidence cannot establish an answer. Inspect only this saved condition, its criteria and binding. Report factual evidence and confidence (0..1 or null). A pass means satisfaction of THIS condition, not an overall edit label. Do not anticipate the optimizer's target. Missing evidence or transport/schema failures must not become a negative observation. The final overall label is computed by code; you never supply it.

observations.evidence: The edited image consistently has a chalk-drawing appearance across both giraffes and the surrounding scene: forms are softened and sketch-like, with visible grainy, dusty texture and chalk-like shading throughout. The treatment covers the main subjects and background rather than appearing only in isolated areas.
